name: The Bridge CRM
description: Enterprise CRM built from scratch into the operational system of record for a 1,000+ member community — managing operations, events, registrations, subscriptions, and donations. Angular SSR with Node and Express API layer.

details.problem: Replaced a client's manual, spreadsheet-based process for events, subscriptions, and donations with a centralized, reliable system of record.
details.role: Sole architect. Designed the data model and API layer from scratch, built the Angular SSR frontend, and delivered the platform end-to-end from first commit to production.
highlights: Architected and shipped the entire CRM from scratch (Angular SSR, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL)
Now the operational system of record for a 1,000+ member community
Designed and implemented 40+ production REST APIs
Supports event management, registrations, subscriptions, and donations

name: HR AI Recruitment Platform
description: AI-powered recruitment automation: candidate sourcing and ranking for hiring teams — combining GPT-based resume scoring with Playwright-driven scraping to process 1,500+ candidate profiles.

details.problem: Hiring teams spent excessive hours manually screening and ranking candidate resumes without consistent matching quality or standardized evaluation.
details.role: Built the AI pipeline end-to-end: OpenAI-powered candidate ranking and matching, Playwright-based browser automation for sourcing, and backend APIs.
highlights: Automated candidate sourcing and ranking with GPT-based resume scoring
Built browser automation for scraping and sourcing with Playwright
Processed 1,500+ candidate profiles, cutting manual screening time significantly
Designed backend APIs powering the full recruitment automation workflow

name: MotoExpert
description: Car service center platform for tracking customer vehicle history and service records. Rebuilt from a legacy Angular/Capacitor web-wrapper into a React Native app with Express + Prisma backend — live and in active use.

details.problem: Legacy Angular/Capacitor web-wrapper had tangled, undocumented APIs, sluggish performance, and no clear data model.
details.role: Rebuilt the platform end-to-end: delivered a native-feel React Native mobile app backed by a redesigned Express and Prisma backend with structured database modeling.
highlights: Rebuilt from legacy Angular/Capacitor web-wrapper to high-performance React Native
Redesigned Express and Prisma backend with structured data modeling
Delivered native app feel, significantly improving speed and UX
Live and in active commercial use for customer vehicle service tracking

name: AgentMesh
description: AI-driven profile-matching product that screens and ranks candidates against client-defined criteria using OpenAI-powered semantic matching, authentication, and backend APIs.

details.problem: Connecting the right professionals required more than keyword search — needed intelligent, context-aware semantic matching against custom client criteria.
details.role: Built the authentication system, backend APIs, and OpenAI-powered semantic recommendation engine driving intelligent profile matching.
highlights: Designed AI-driven matching using OpenAI for intelligent semantic recommendations
Built authentication and authorization from scratch
Developed backend APIs with Node.js and PostgreSQL
Delivered context-aware profile suggestions beyond simple keyword search
